obs: - [benefit] The inline Add Task row stays open after Enter, so the second Feature X task was added with a single typed line and a 'Task created' toast offered View task / Copy URL.

- [benefit] The + at the end of the list header opened a Fields panel where Dropdown was the first popular type, and a 'Priority' field with High/Low options was created in four actions on the free plan.
- [friction] The dropdown field form starts with placeholder options 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' that have to be overwritten one at a time, and the Fields panel covers most of the task list while open.
- [friction] ClickUp already has a built-in flag-style Priority on every card, so creating a custom 'Priority' dropdown gives no warning about duplicating that built-in field.
- [benefit] A Board (Kanban) view tab already existed on the list next to List, so the Kanban view needed one click rather than setup.
- [benefit] Dragging the Demo Alpha card from TO DO to IN PROGRESS worked in one drag, with column counts updating immediately (5 to 4, 0 to 1).

- [friction] The new workspace was pre-filled with Project 1, Project 2 and placeholder Task 1-3 items, so my Feature X tasks ended up mixed in with demo clutter unless I spent extra steps creating a new list or deleting them.
- [friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.
obs_filtered: - [benefit] The inline Add Task row stays open after Enter, so the second Feature X task was added with a single typed line and a 'Task created' toast offered View task / Copy URL.
- [friction] The dropdown field form starts with placeholder options 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' that have to be overwritten one at a time, and the Fields panel covers most of the task list while open.
- [friction] ClickUp already has a built-in flag-style Priority on every card, so creating a custom 'Priority' dropdown gives no warning about duplicating that built-in field.
- [benefit] A Board (Kanban) view tab already existed on the list next to List, so the Kanban view needed one click rather than setup.
- [benefit] Dragging the Demo Alpha card from TO DO to IN PROGRESS worked in one drag, with column counts updating immediately (5 to 4, 0 to 1).
- [friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.
